incident_id.description: Unique identifier for an incident affecting API monetization

api_product_id.description: Identifier of an API product or plan impacted by the incident

tenant_id.description: Identifier of the tenant or customer workspace

subscription_id.description: Identifier for a specific API subscription or contract

mitigation_id.description: Identifier for a specific mitigation or workaround action applied during an incident

compensation_id.description: Identifier for a compensation or credit note issued due to the incident

incident_impact.description: Structured impact information for an incident

estimated_revenue_impact.description: Estimated net revenue impact (positive for gain, negative for loss) in major currency units

time_window.description: Time window used across functions to scope metrics and impact
